ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated in a central 'V' shape at the median notch and along the thin trailing edge margins. Multiple low-intensity focal spots and linear streaks are distributed across both medial and lateral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature across both lobes, tapering to narrow lateral tips that curve slightly upward and outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small dark circular pixel clusters on the right lobe; one distinct dark semi-circular mark on the distal right lobe near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed; most prominent are vertical and diagonal streaks on the medial-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical linear scars/rake marks on the right lobe surface; significant dark pigmentation scarring around the central notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark, semi-circular/hook-shaped marking on the upper right lobe distal region, roughly 10% inward from the tip.
